\section*{Resumen de orientacion}
This document provides reusable outreach templates for the international job-search system.

\section*{Contenido completo depurado}
\addcontentsline{toc}{section}{Contenido completo depurado}




\subsection{Purpose}




This document provides reusable outreach templates for the international job-search system.




It includes English and Spanish versions for:




\begin{itemize}
\item recruiter connection messages;
\item hiring manager messages;
\item technical art lead messages;
\item Unity technical director messages;
\item XR / simulation / digital twin companies;
\item creative technology studios;
\item game studio recruiters;
\item speculative applications;
\item referral requests;
\item professor / advisor recommendation requests;
\item former freelance client testimonial requests;
\item follow-ups;
\item salary expectation responses;
\item remote-from-Colombia explanations;
\item contractor setup explanations;
\item future Portuguese / EU mobility explanations;
\item contract/payment questions;
\item declining unstable offers;
\item explaining low formal experience;
\item explaining AI-assisted development;
\item answering “Why should we hire you?”
\end{itemize}




The goal is to support consistent, direct, non-desperate, evidence-based communication.




\medskip\hrule\medskip




\section{1. Messaging principles}




\subsection{Core positioning}




Every message should reinforce this identity:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Real-Time 3D Developer / Unity Technical Artist focused on interactive technical visualization, CAD-to-realtime optimization, and Unity WebGL deployment.
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{Primary proof}




Use TwinSight X500 as the main proof asset.




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
TwinSight X500 = Unity WebGL technical visualization prototype for drone assembly inspection.
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{Secondary proof}




Use ARA only when relevant:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
ARA Framework = Python/LangGraph research automation prototype.
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{Tone}




Use:




\begin{itemize}
\item direct;
\item technically specific;
\item concise;
\item evidence-based;
\item no begging;
\item no exaggerated enthusiasm;
\item no inflated seniority.
\end{itemize}




Avoid:




\begin{itemize}
\item “I am passionate about everything tech”;
\item “I would love any opportunity”;
\item “I can do anything”;
\item long autobiographical explanations;
\item overexplaining legal status;
\item overexplaining AI usage unless asked.
\end{itemize}




\medskip\hrule\medskip




\section{2. Personalization variables}




Use these placeholders:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
[Name]
[Company]
[Role]
[Project / product]
[Why they fit]
[Portfolio URL]
[TwinSight URL]
[GitHub URL]
[LinkedIn URL]
[CV URL]
[Your email]
[Date]
[Salary range]
[Time zone overlap]
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{Minimum personalization per message}




Every message should include at least:




\begin{enumerate}
\item company name;
\item relevant role or product;
\item why TwinSight is related;
\item portfolio or GitHub link.
\end{enumerate}

Subject: Recommendation request — TwinSight X500 / Unity technical visualization

Hi Professor [Name],

I am preparing my international job-search materials around TwinSight X500 and my profile as a Real-Time 3D Developer / Unity Technical Artist focused on technical visualization.

Alexander

\section{17. Remote-from-Colombia explanation}




\subsection{English}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
I’m currently based in Colombia and available for remote contractor/B2B work.

I can collaborate with international teams using overlap with US or European time zones depending on the schedule. For payroll-style employment, the company would need to confirm whether it supports an EOR or local-compliance setup. For contractor work, I can operate through invoice-based arrangements subject to Colombian tax and administrative requirements.
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{Spanish}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text

Para trabajo como contractor, puedo operar mediante facturación, sujeto a los requisitos tributarios y administrativos en Colombia.
\end{mdcode}

\section{18. Contractor setup explanation}




\subsection{English}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
For contractor work, I can work under a B2B / independent contractor agreement with defined scope, payment terms, deliverables, confidentiality and IP clauses.

Before signing, I would review:

- payment method and currency;
- invoicing requirements;
- tax documentation;
- IP ownership;
- confidentiality;
- termination terms;
- expected availability;
- whether the relationship is contractor or employee-like.

This helps keep the structure clear for both sides.
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{Spanish}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Para trabajo como contractor, puedo trabajar bajo un acuerdo B2B / prestación de servicios independiente con alcance, términos de pago, entregables, confidencialidad y propiedad intelectual definidos.

Antes de firmar, revisaría:

- método y moneda de pago;
- requisitos de facturación;
- documentación tributaria;
- propiedad intelectual;
- confidencialidad;
- causales de terminación;
- disponibilidad esperada;
- si la relación es realmente contractor o se parece a empleo.

Esto ayuda a mantener clara la estructura para ambas partes.
\end{mdcode}

\section{21. Contract / payment / benefits questions}




\subsection{English}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Before moving forward, I’d like to clarify a few contract details:

1. Is the role employee, contractor, B2B, or EOR-based?
2. What is the expected weekly availability?
3. What time-zone overlap is required?
4. What is the payment currency and method?
5. What are the payment terms?
6. Are there paid time off, holidays or sick-day provisions?
7. How is IP ownership handled?
8. Are there exclusivity or non-compete clauses?
9. What equipment or software is provided?
10. What is the termination notice period?
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{Spanish}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Antes de avanzar, me gustaría aclarar algunos puntos del contrato:

1. ¿El rol es empleado, contractor, B2B o vía EOR?
2. ¿Cuál es la disponibilidad semanal esperada?
3. ¿Qué solapamiento horario se requiere?
4. ¿Cuál es la moneda y método de pago?
5. ¿Cuáles son los términos de pago?
6. ¿Hay vacaciones, festivos o días de enfermedad pagos?
7. ¿Cómo se maneja la propiedad intelectual?
8. ¿Hay exclusividad o cláusulas de no competencia?
9. ¿La empresa proporciona equipo o software?
10. ¿Cuál es el periodo de preaviso para terminación?
\end{mdcode}

\section{31. Message quality checklist}




Before sending, verify:




\begin{itemize}
\item [ ] Message names the company or person.
\item [ ] Message mentions a relevant area.
\item [ ] TwinSight is included if relevant.
\item [ ] Portfolio link is included.
\item [ ] Message is under 180 words unless email.
\item [ ] No false claims.
\item [ ] No desperate wording.
\item [ ] No overexplaining legal status.
\item [ ] No giant biography.
\item [ ] No attachment unless requested.
\item [ ] Clear next action.
\end{itemize}

\section{33. Templates not to use}




Avoid:




\begin{mdcode}

I’m looking for any job.
I’m passionate and hardworking.
I can do web, AI, 3D, games, design and everything.

I used AI to make everything.

I’m almost an EU citizen.
I accept any salary.

These reduce credibility or create legal/positioning risk.
